replies.subject: Re: A European angle on your L.A. has 20,000 vacant lots. They could help solve its housi piece
replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

I don't think I got a note from you last week, but thanks for reaching out.

Interested in what data you might have -- do you mean fire-resistant
housing?
Would love to learn more.
Grace Toohey

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 11:12 PM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hello,
>
> Wanted to reconnect in case my note last week slipped through — happy
> to share a data point that may be useful. LA County permits for
> noncombustible residential construction have risen sharply since 2025,
> suggesting the market is starting to bend toward this approach rather
> than treating it as niche.
>
> Happy to share the underlying data if useful for an upcoming piece.
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>


-- 
*Grace Toohey*
*Los Angeles Times*
(c) 310-648-9866
